part.Name: Description
part.Short: The horticulturalists are responsible for the maintenance of the Toxic Arboretum they call home. Unique among the Truekin, they are known to consume the plants of Qud to temporarily manifest psychic powers of organic manipulation.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Arborists are responsible for maintaining the great trees that make up the toxic Ekuemekiyyen jungle, and discovering new specimens throughout the world. Unique among the Truekin, they are known to consume the plants of qud to temporarily manifest psychic powers of plant growth.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Jungleshapers gather, grow and protect the toxic Jungle that encompasses the River Null on both sides. Unique among the Truekin, they are known to consume the plants of qud to temporarily manifest psychic powers of plant growth.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The priesthood of the Toxic Arboretum is a dual one- worshipping the dual aspects of the Syzgy. These priests lead during the peaceful day, when the Ekuemekiyyens rest, and prepare for the savagery of the Moon.

part.Name: Leader
part.popTable: Aric Priest of all Suns Bodyguard1

part.Name: Description
part.Short: It is said that a willing sacrifice pleases the sun most highly. It is thus that the Priests of all Suns are extremely persuasive. One way or another.

part.Name: Leader
part.popTable: Aric Priest of all Suns Bodyguard2

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Archpriests are among the high leadership of Ekuemekiyye, responsible for the peaceful day, and the preparation of sacrifices for the priesthood of the Moon.

part.Name: Leader
part.popTable: Aric Priest of all Suns Bodyguard3

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The priesthood of the Toxic Arboretum is a dual one- worshipping the dual aspects of the Syzgy. These priests lead during the night, when the savage moon rules, and are responsible for the sacrificial rites that cause the new sun to be born with each coming dawn.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: These warrior-priests lead hunting parties throughout the Arboretum and beyond. The responsibility of ensuring the Dawn is a great one.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Archpriests lead only the most savage hunts on the Night of the Black Moon, where none that are caught survive to the altar.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The pelt-caped Syzgyrior serve the dual priesthood of Ekuemekiyye as warriors, servants and hunters of sacrifice. Many are said to believe themselves to absorb the power of those they slay, and often keep grisly trophies.

inventoryobject.Blueprint: Aric Fanged Sun and Moon Mask

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The twin souls of the Syzgyrior serve the sun and moon equally, prowling through the jungle for sacrifice, and guarding the cities through the day of rest.

inventoryobject.Blueprint: Aric Toxic Fanged Sun and Moon Mask

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The greatest of the Syzgyrior eschew the cloaks of their brethren in favour of emulating a beast. Most terrifying of all is the arachnowarrior, the many blades and toxic fangs wearing down the defences of any foe.

inventoryobject.Blueprint: Aric Toxic Fanged Sun and Moon Mask

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The pelt-caped Syzgyrior serve the dual priesthood of Ekuemekiyye as warriors, servants and hunters of sacrifice. The youngest of this caste, yet to be selected by a master, serve the Ziggurat to which they were born.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: In the deepest forges beneath the great shrouded Ziggurats, crushing crysteel plates were layered over a serpentine frame of machine muscle. Caustic reagents were combined and injected into tumbling units and fed into facsimile salivary glands. The chromewrights actualised the greatest defender of the people of the Syzgy; the greatest terror to it's enemies.

part.Name: VehiclePilotPopulation
part.Blueprint: Aric Priest of All Moons 3,Aric Syzgyrior 3

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Far to the east of the Null river, behind the shield mountains of the Nubai Shelf, is the lofty Ziggurat of the Cat, set upon the foundations of an ancient monastery. There, the chromewrights forged their greatest weapon- the power of the storm, captured within a crysteel frame.

part.Name: VehiclePilotPopulation
part.Blueprint: Aric Priest of All Moons 3,Aric Syzgyrior 3

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Claiming a line of descent of master to apprentice stretching back to the eaters, the Artifices construct all manner of wonders for their Consular Executors.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Ibul Savants lead their studios in the manufacture of and development of new cybernetics, servitors and other such technology. On such wonders, is the military and economic might of the Ice Sheathed Arcology built.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Ingenium is the highest rank an Artifex can hope to reach. In incredible demand, they are the pride of whichever tower is able to command their allegiance.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Every tower within the Ice Sheathed arcology is ruled by their Chief Executor. The Will of these Executors trickles down through every level of the consulate- these indiviudals are responsible for ensuring their will is done.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The Magisters hold the sacred duty of management. They are responsible for ensuring the productivity of their myriad subdivisions, from nutrient production to diplomatic relations

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Princeps often have the great honour of becoming Directors of the various divisions within each tower. Some even gain that most esteemed positon of Assistant to the Executor.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The Praetorian caste are the warriors of Ibul, enforcing the will of the Executors and defending their assets from both external threats from the glacial plains and the ambition of rivals.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Bodyguards and warriors for the great and true, Tribunes are drawn from the lower ranks by grading their indicators of key performance. In spite of such a method, they are extremely competent.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Praetorian Prefects are the only warriors trusted to protect the lives and personal assets of the Chief Executors of the various towers of Ibul. A lifetime of surpassing annual targets and meeting indicators has left them well equipped for a hostile world.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A great beast and noble companion, the great war hounds of the Glacial Plains are said to be a breed above their kin in Qud. Capable of chasing down and harrying their foes, great salt encrusted spikes around their necks promise swift vengeance against retaliation.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Without loyalty to their progeny, members of the Eunuch caste are trusted to serve in all manner of position within the Ibul hierarchy. With all emotion stunted by powerful chemical processes, they carry out their grim duties with dispassionate efficiency.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: There are many routes to power for the Consuls of Ibul's many spires. Assassination is but one tool in their arsenal, though one at which the Eunuchs excel. While officially existing outside the jurisdiction of any individual tower, consuls have been known to keep particularly able Eunuchs on retainer, keeping a valuable tool to hand as needed, and depriving it of their rivals.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The Manus Mortis deal death with a cybernetically fixed smile. No longer permitted by the Eunuch Patriarch to subcontract, they serve only the instituation that created them.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A chromium shell approximates a human form. At the very bottom of the executorial hierarchy, these androids are used to fulfil the base needs of a society otherwise hyper focused on specialised productivity.

part.Name: Description
part.Short:
When the screaming hordes of Uutut the Boorish clashed with the 2nd Praetorian Legion on blasted Arthax, the vast numbers of flesh eating screamers threatened to overwhelm the far smaller force. The victory of the legion that day is ascribed to superior firepower of their spaser weaponry, and the novel shield locking formation inspired by the beast their standard bore.
And so did the great artifices of the tower emulate this victory, through the rime encrusted shoulder cannon of the tundra, the kaleidoscopic churn of it's plasmatic artillery and it's impregnable crysteel carapace.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: When the black stair fell upon the earth and the Fuming God claimed their sea, only the brave or the foolish dared cast off in search of vital trade. Those that returned were named Fuming God-child, and in time, became the sole masters of those waves.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Atop their black glass spires, the nine Gas Eaters dwell. Consuming the fumes of the deep that rise through their domains, they see visions of the past, the present and the future. They are served by the Seers, who will one day replace them, when the toxic nature of acting as divine conduit takes it's toll. In the wider world, they act as divine instruments- enforcing the divine will across the Archipelago.

inventoryobject.Blueprint: Aric Fuming Conch of the Aji

part.Name: Render
part.DisplayName: Fuming God-Child Avatar of the Aji

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The Fuming Gods protect and humble the people of the Crustal Mortars with their pyroclast. When A Fuming God-Child gains such mastery over that same power, how can they be anything but divine?

inventoryobject.Blueprint: Aric Erupting Conch of the Aji

object.Name: Aric Child of the Wheel Apprentice

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Equal parts mining unit, combat machine and scout- the rockbreaker is employed by the most elite members of the Children of the Deep caste to search for valuable gem and mineral deposits, slay the dangerous deep dwellers that threaten the subterranean connections between the islands of the black stair, and to carve out their new cavernous homes deep beneath the seafloor.

object.Name: Aric Priest of All Suns Commander

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A hemisphere inverts the mass of the emplacement, defying the gravitonic pull of the world above which it floats.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Genetically modifed strain of the terrible Tongue Tyrant flower. Crafted in the black vaults below the Ziggurats of the Arboreta, these plants trade some of their indiviudal deadliness for a tolerance to poison that is particularly advantageous in the toxic, cultivated jungles they now call home. When transplanted to Qud, they make for excellent organic fortifications.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The smell of rotting flesh clings to the air around the large fleshy petals of the the Poisonbloom of the Arboreta. One of the many creations from the Ziggurat vaults that give the toxic Arboreta their deadly reputation. The cloying stench that attracts it's insectoid prey is the remains of the many living beings it has ingested, their proteins repurposed to create a deadly toxic mist- hence it's common name: The Ekuemekiyyen Corpse Flower.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Steel treads turn around a drive sprocket, toting a chrome spine and featureless sensor array. Stuck on =pronouns.possessive= grooved, steel arms are two big rotary saws, rust-dulled.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Shing burls spin across =pronouns.possessive= plate-metal back and, out the back of =pronouns.possessive= neck, silver antennae lick and taste the air. Attached to =pronouns.possessive= arm stumps is a pair of monstrous cone drill pins, spinning, to pulverize and dig out stone or bone.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Deer legs threateningly paw the ground, preparing to charge. The characteristic anxiety of the Hindren has metamorphosed into an explosive fury, bubbling barely beneath the surface. Wild eyes show a bloodlust that has propelled this hindren to Chieftain.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Bulging muscles and teeth sharpened to a point. Bloodcrazed eyes hungrily stare out on a world of meat. The warriors of the skycleave clan inspire fear across the jungle, renowned for their ravenous ferocity.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Celestial knowledge and psychic power attract a ceaseless procession of hunters, seeking to bring one into the fold. Espers that trust in strangers rarely grow old.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: At the moribund instant, with the mindvenom of the voider coursing through their veins, Kimuukat-no-longer ceased to be, and Kimuukat-one-more became. Seizing that final breath, with a new promise of life, the predator became servant and the spidermaster assumed their mantle.

object.Name: Aric Apostle of the Sightless Way

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The muscles knit across =pronouns.possessive= spine have shrunken to near-nothing, and the pleats in =pronouns.possessive= ornamental kittel sag in their absence. =pronouns.Subjective= vibrates to the frequency of another timeplace.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: An artifact of the eaters allows the defiance of gravity. These ancient pillars of chrome still hold watch over the halls of their long departed masters.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: An artifact of the eaters allows the defiance of gravity. These ancient pillars of chrome still seek out programmed foes long since reduced to dust by the passing of millenia.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Dextrous fingers play along the leather of their bolas, and muscles twitch in expectation of violence. Under their watch, none will escape the stockade.

part.Name: Render
part.DisplayName: Naraah Stargazer, Abramite of the Goatfolk Clans

part.Name: Render
part.DisplayName: Zutule Ka, Priest of the Moon

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Tattered, bloodstained ceremonial robes hang from the thin shoulders of the captured priest. From beneath the bone white mask, hatred stares out at those that would have been sacrifices. In spite of their defeat, pride still stirs within the breast, and the priest prowls the cage like a caged beast.

part.Name: Render
part.DisplayName: Zutule Ka, Priest of the Moon

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Tattered, bloodstained ceremonial robes have been replaced by pristine emerald silks. A blade of moonlight hangs carelessly from a waistbound slash of white. Even from beneath a mask that entirely obscures the face, a proud sneer can be felt pouring from the eyeslits.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A body time-fit to living in the smalls of spiral roots is kept warm by a layer of symbiotic moss-fur. Once bright eyes, deadened by the inevitability of oblivion, stare blankly from beneath the selfsame mask of =pronouns.possessive= minyan. The portrait of togetherness now twisted with wrenching irony- agony is now their only shared experience.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A snow white slumping head is beset with keen and soft red eyes. =pronouns.Possessive= once powdery fur is now crossed with seeping weltss and scars on =pronouns.possessive= hulking ape-frame, and the instinct to chest-beat is savagely prevented by chafing bonds.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A braid of roasted frogskin stretches taut over =pronouns.possessive= swollen pectorals and fastens a satchel to =pronouns.possessive= hip. =pronouns.Possessive= hooves are stained with an unclassified mixture of blood, and spittle flies from =pronouns.possessive= bleating mouth into a tuft of scraggle chin-hair. Their hands have been bound with thick rope, and the inevitability of their impending offering to the Syzgy has dulled the fire behind their eyes.
